_about: Allowlist of prior input-file SHAs that are content-equivalent to a current SHA for scoring purposes. Consulted by tests/test_published_runs.py when a published run's recorded SHA does not match the live file. Each entry must document the diff and a verifying reviewer so a reader can audit why the equivalence holds.

1b2fe36f2d19971a4f66e9f47462bac75926b386.diff_summary: PR #31 (b31185f) dropped repair_prompt_named and repair_prompt_deictic fields from every task. These fields were only consumed by the --enable-repair flow that the same PR also removed. Candidate prompts (turn_1_user, turn_2_user, scene descriptions) and judge inputs (answer lists, gold labels) are unchanged.
